error.rest_key_missing: KAKAO_REST_API_KEY not configured (same REST key as KakaoTalk module).
error.transcoord_xy_required: transcoord needs numeric x and y. They are values in `inputCoord` units and may not be degrees at all (TM and WTM are metres).
error.coord_system_invalid: {{field}} is not a valid coordinate system. Available: {{systems}}
error.distance_sort_needs_center: sort:"distance" requires a centre. Supply lat_center and lon_center.
error.category_area_required: Category search ({{code}}) requires a search area: either lat_center/lon_center (with radius) or rect. There is no nationwide category listing.
error.route_coords_required: Directions need both origin and destination coordinates. Missing: {{missing}}
error.route_not_found: No {{action}} route was found (status: {{status}}). This comes back when origin and destination are the same, when there is no road or stop nearby, or when the two points are too far apart.
error.static_map_center_required: A static map needs either a centre (centerLat/centerLon) or markers. With neither, there is nothing to centre the image on.
